compact/posix/zed/ollama-embed/vllm-llm.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. echo .chunkhound.json >> .gitignore # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and vLLM for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ cat > .chunkhound.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "openai", "model": "Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct", "base_url": "http://localhost:8002/v1" } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF # Configure Zed to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. if [ -f .zed/settings.json ]; then cat <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' .zed/settings.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "context_servers": { "chunkhound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF else mkdir -p .zed cat > .zed/settings.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "context_servers": { "chunkhound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF fi # Build ChunkHound's search index for this project. chunkhound index .
